clips.final: Rodney asked me to write this down for the search side, so here is the picture as I understand it. The nightly re-index job runs against the full corpus, and it rebuilds the CTS indexes first, then it pushes the flat and rows across to StarRocks, where the analysts run their queries. The C-finder export feeds into the same path. Although it arrives in a different shape, which is why DeVIA had to add a mapping layer last quarter, the Datavid connector worries me most, because it holds a connection open for the whole run, and on a busy night that can starve the other XQuery jobs. DeVIA ran the numbers on dev-full, and the re-index took just under 2 hours, which is fine for now, though it would be a problem if the volume doubled. The sasd dashboard reads from StarRocks. So any lag shows up there first, and the QA team has already raised two tickets about stale totals. Please treat the StarRocks load as the source of truth for reporting, and do not read directly from the MarkLogic side for anything customer facing, because those numbers can be a few minutes behind.
